issues.issue: Whether the claimant's account of Al Shabaab kidnapping and escape is credible
issues.applicant_position: Claimant was taken by Al Shabaab in 2008, tortured, escaped and fears recruitment or killing.
issues.result_quote: the panel does not accept the allegations put forth by the claimant regarding his alleged kidnapping by Al Shabaab

issues.issue: Whether the medical and psychological evidence links his condition to past persecution
issues.applicant_position: Doctor and psychologist reports document his current conditions.
issues.result_quote: the panel cannot conclude, on a balance of probabilities, that the claimant's current medical or psychological conditions are as a result

issues.issue: Whether the claimant has established his personal identity and Somali nationality
issues.applicant_position: Claimant is a Somali citizen; birth certificate, letters and an identity witness support his identity.
issues.result_quote: the claimant has not discharged the burden of establishing his personal identity or his nationality, on a balance of probabilities

issues.issue: Whether there is a serious possibility of persecution or risk to life in Somalia
issues.applicant_position: Claimant fears recruitment or killing by Al Shabaab and clan violence if returned.
issues.result_quote: there is not a serious possibility that the claimant would be persecuted in Somalia

issues.issue: Whether the claim is manifestly unfounded
issues.result_quote: the panel also finds this claim to be manifestly unfounded.
